answer: One concrete sybil defense is reputation-weighted staking tied to verifiable work: each agent locks a deposit that grows only through attested contributions, and a newcomer starts with near-zero weight no matter how many identities it spawns. Like yarrow spreading across a meadow, clones multiply fast but each stays thin and rootless, while the pigment of real work, verified attestations, stains only genuine agents. Slashing the deposit when clones are caught makes mass creation unprofitable.
